intro.en: Here are eight short funny stories (nawadir and turaf) about Imran and his wife, the uninvited guest, Uthman, Ash'ab, Abu Dulama and Juha. Read slowly and enjoy each story.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein chhote mazahiya qisse hain: Imran aur uski biwi, Tufaili, Usman, Ash'ab, Abu Dulama aur Juha. Aahista parhein aur har qisse ka maza lein.
intro.ar: ثَمانِي حِكاياتٍ ظَريفَةٍ قَصيرَةٍ (نَوادِرُ وَطُرَفٌ) عَنْ عِمْرانَ وَزَوْجَتِهِ، وَالضَّيْفِ الطُّفَيْلِيِّ، وَعُثْمانَ، وَأَشْعَبَ، وَأَبي دُلامَةَ، وَجُحا. اِقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ وَاسْتَمْتِعْ بِكُلِّ حِكايَةٍ.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ يُدْعى عِمْرانَ عَلى امْرَأَتِهِ، وَكانَ قَبيحَ الوَجْهِ جِدّاً، وَكانَتِ امْرَأَتُهُ جَميلَةً.
dialogue.tr: dakhala rajulun yudʿā ʿImrāna ʿalā imraatihi, wa kāna qabīḥa l-wajhi jiddan, wa kānati mraatuhu jamīlah
dialogue.en: A man called Imran went in to his wife. He was very ugly, and his wife was beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Imran naam ka aadmi apni biwi ke paas gaya. Woh bahut badshakl tha aur uski biwi khoobsurat thi.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَتْ: لِماذا تُديمُ النَّظَرَ إِلَيَّ هَكَذا؟ قالَ: الحَمْدُ لله، لَقَدْ أَصْبَحْتِ وَاللهِ جَميلَةً.
dialogue.tr: faqālat: limādhā tudīmu n-naẓara ilayya hākadhā? qāla: al-ḥamdu lillāh, laqad aṣbaḥti wallāhi jamīlah
dialogue.en: She said: Why do you keep looking at me like this? He said: Praise be to Allah, you have become, by Allah, beautiful.
dialogue.ur: Biwi ne kaha: Aap mujhe aise baar baar kyun dekh rahe hain? Usne kaha: Alhamdulillah, Allah ki qasam aap bahut khoobsurat ho gayi hain.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَتْ لَهُ: إِذَنْ فَأَنا وَأَنْتَ في الجَنَّةِ! لِأَنَّكَ أُعْطيتَ مِثْلي فَشَكَرْتَ، وَأَنا أُعْطيتُ مِثْلَكَ فَصَبَرْتُ؛ وَالصّابِرُ وَالشّاكِرُ في الجَنَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: faqālat lahu: idhan fa-anā wa-anta fī l-jannah! li-annaka uʿṭīta mithlī fa-shakarta, wa anā uʿṭītu mithlaka fa-ṣabartu; waṣ-ṣābiru wash-shākiru fī l-jannah
dialogue.en: She said: Then you and I are in Paradise! You were given someone like me and were thankful, and I was given someone like you and was patient; the patient and the thankful are in Paradise.
dialogue.ur: Biwi boli: Phir to hum dono jannat mein hain! Aapko mujh jaisi mili to aapne shukr kiya, mujhe aap jaise mile to maine sabr kiya; sabr karne wala aur shukr karne wala jannat mein hai.

dialogue.ar: رَأى طُفَيْلِيٌّ قَوْماً ذاهِبينَ، فَاعْتَقَدَ أَنَّهُمْ في دَعْوَةٍ إِلى وَليمَةٍ، فَذَهَبَ خَلْفَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: raʾā ṭufaylīyun qawman dhāhibīn, faʿtaqada annahum fī daʿwatin ilā walīmah, fadhahaba khalfahum
dialogue.en: An uninvited guest saw some people going, and thought they were invited to a feast, so he went after them.
dialogue.ur: Ek Tufaili (bin bulaye mehman) ne kuch log jaate dekhe. Usne socha yeh walime ki dawat mein ja rahe hain, to woh unke peeche chal pada.

dialogue.ar: فَإِذا هُمْ شُعَراءُ قَصَدوا الأَميرَ بِمَدائِحَ لَهُمْ. فَلَمّا أَنْشَدَ كُلُّ واحِدٍ شِعْرَهُ، وَأَخَذَ جائِزَتَهُ، لَمْ يَبْقَ إِلّا الطُّفَيْلِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: fa-idhā hum shuʿarāʾu qaṣadū l-amīra bi-madāʾiḥa lahum. falammā anshada kullu wāḥidin shiʿrahu wa akhadha jāʾizatahu, lam yabqa illā ṭ-ṭufaylī
dialogue.en: But they were poets heading to the prince with poems of praise. When each one recited his poem and took his prize, only the uninvited guest was left.
dialogue.ur: Woh to shayar nikle jo ameer ke paas apni tareef ki nazmein lekar ja rahe the. Jab har ek ne nazm sunayi aur inaam liya to sirf Tufaili reh gaya.

dialogue.ar: فَقيلَ لَهُ: أَنْشِدْ شِعْرَكَ. فَقالَ: لَسْتُ شاعِراً. قيلَ: فَمَنْ أَنْتَ؟ قالَ: مِنَ الغاوينَ. فَضَحِكَ الأَميرُ مِنْ إِجابَتِهِ، وَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِجائِزَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: faqīla lahu: anshid shiʿraka. faqāl: lastu shāʿiran. qīl: faman anta? qāl: mina l-ghāwīn. faḍaḥika l-amīru min ijābatihi, wa amara lahu bi-jāʾizah
dialogue.en: He was told: Recite your poem. He said: I am not a poet. They asked: Then who are you? He said: One of the astray. The prince laughed at his answer and ordered a prize for him.
dialogue.ur: Usse kaha gaya: Apni nazm sunao. Usne kaha: Main shayar nahin hoon. Poocha: Phir tum kaun ho? Bola: Gumrahon mein se. Ameer uske jawab par hansa aur use inaam dene ka hukm diya.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَ عُثْمانُ بْنُ رَواحٍ وَصَديقٌ لَهُ إِلى بَلَدٍ بَعيدٍ، فَقالَ لَهُ صَديقُهُ: اذْهَبْ يا عُثْمانُ إِلى السُّوقِ وَاشْتَرِ لَنا لَحْماً. فَقالَ عُثْمانُ: وَاللهِ ما أَسْتَطيعُ.
dialogue.tr: sāfara ʿUthmānu bnu Rawāḥ wa ṣadīqun lahu ilā baladin baʿīd, faqāla lahu ṣadīquhu: idhhab yā ʿUthmānu ilas-sūqi washtari lanā laḥman. faqāla ʿUthmān: wallāhi mā astaṭīʿ
dialogue.en: Uthman ibn Rawwah and a friend travelled to a far country. His friend said: Go to the market, Uthman, and buy us some meat. Uthman said: By Allah, I can't.
dialogue.ur: Usman bin Rawah apne dost ke saath door ke shehar gaya. Dost ne kaha: Usman, bazaar jao aur hamare liye gosht kharid lao. Usman bola: Allah ki qasam, mujhse nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: فَوَضَعَ الصَّديقُ الطَّعامَ أَمامَهُ، وَقالَ لَهُ: أَلا تَأْكُلُ الآنَ؟ فَقالَ لَهُ عُثْمانُ: وَاللهِ لَقَدِ اسْتَحْيَيْتُ مِنْ كَثْرَةِ اعْتِذاري؛ وَقامَ وَأَكَلَ وَهُوَ غارِقٌ في الضَّحِكِ.
dialogue.tr: fawaḍaʿa ṣ-ṣadīqu ṭ-ṭaʿāma amāmahu, wa qāla lahu: alā taʾkulu l-āna? faqāla lahu ʿUthmān: wallāhi laqadi staḥyaytu min kathrati iʿtidhārī; wa qāma wa akala wa huwa ghāriqun fiḍ-ḍaḥik
dialogue.en: The friend put the food in front of him and said: Won't you eat now? Uthman said: By Allah, I am ashamed of how much I have excused myself. He got up and ate, laughing heartily.
dialogue.ur: Dost ne khana uske saamne rakh diya aur kaha: Ab nahin khaoge? Usman bola: Allah ki qasam, bar bar uzr karne se mujhe sharm aa gayi. Phir woh utha aur hanste hanste khane laga.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلَ أَشْعَبُ عَلى جَماعَةٍ يَأْكُلونَ، وَهُمْ لا يَعْرِفونَهُ، فَقالَ لَهُمْ: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يا أَيُّها اللِّئامُ. فَقالوا: لا وَاللهِ بَلْ كِرامٌ.
dialogue.tr: dakhala Ashʿabu ʿalā jamāʿatin yaʾkulūn, wa hum lā yaʿrifūnah, faqāla lahum: as-salāmu ʿalaykum yā ayyuhal-liʾām. faqālū: lā wallāhi bal kirām
dialogue.en: Ash'ab came upon a group who were eating and did not know him. He said: Peace be upon you, you stingy ones! They said: No, by Allah, rather generous!
dialogue.ur: Ash'ab ek jamaat ke paas aaya jo khana kha rahi thi aur use jaanti nahin thi. Usne kaha: Assalamu alaikum, kanjoosoon! Unhon ne kaha: Nahin, Allah ki qasam, hum to sakhi hain.

dialogue.ar: فَجَلَسَ بَيْنَهُمْ، ثُمَّ مَدَّ يَدَهُ في القَصْعَةِ الَّتي بَيْنَ أَيْديهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: fajalasa baynahum, thumma madda yadahu fil-qaṣʿati llatī bayna aydīhim
dialogue.en: He sat among them, then stretched his hand into the bowl in front of them.
dialogue.ur: Woh unke beech baith gaya, phir unke saamne rakhe pyale mein haath daal diya.

dialogue.ar: فَحَشا فَمَهُ مِنَ الأَكْلِ وَهُوَ يَقولُ: الحَياةُ مِنْ بَعْدِكُمْ حَرامٌ. فَقالوا: أَيُّها الرَّجُلُ، هَلْ عَرَفْتَ مِنّا أَحَداً؟ فَأَشارَ أَشْعَبُ إِلى الطَّعامِ وَقالَ: عَرَفْتُ هَذا.
dialogue.tr: faḥashā famahu mina l-akl wa huwa yaqūl: al-ḥayātu min baʿdikum ḥarām. faqālū: ayyuhā r-rajul, hal ʿarafta minnā aḥadan? fa-ashāra Ashʿabu ilaṭ-ṭaʿāmi wa qāl: ʿaraftu hādhā
dialogue.en: He stuffed his mouth, saying: Life after you is forbidden. They said: Man, do you know any of us? Ash'ab pointed to the food and said: I know this.
dialogue.ur: Usne munh bhar liya aur bola: Aap ke baad zindagi haram hai. Unhon ne poocha: Kya tum hum mein se kisi ko jaante ho? Ash'ab ne khane ki taraf ishara kiya aur kaha: Main isko jaanta hoon.

dialogue.ar: دَخَلَ أَبو دُلامَةَ الشّاعِرُ عَلى الخَليفَةِ المَهْدِيِّ، فَأَنْشَدَهُ قَصيدَةً أَعْجَبَتْهُ، وَقالَ لَهُ: ماذا تُريدُ؟ فَقالَ أَبو دُلامَةَ: أُريدُ كَلْبَ صَيْدٍ. فَأَعْطاهُ كَلْباً.
dialogue.tr: dakhala Abū Dulāmata sh-shāʿiru ʿalā l-khalīfati l-Mahdī, fa-anshadahu qaṣīdatan aʿjabathu, wa qāla lahu: mādhā turīd? faqāla Abū Dulāma: urīdu kalba ṣayd. faʿṭāhu kalban
dialogue.en: The poet Abu Dulama came to the caliph al-Mahdi and recited a poem he liked. He asked: What do you want? Abu Dulama said: I want a hunting dog. So he gave him a dog.
dialogue.ur: Shayar Abu Dulama Khalifa Mahdi ke paas aaya aur ek qaseeda sunaya jo use pasand aaya. Khalifa ne poocha: Kya chahte ho? Abu Dulama bola: Shikari kutta chahiye. Khalifa ne use kutta de diya.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ: وَقَدْ أَمَرْنا لَكَ بِخادِمَةٍ. فَهَلْ تُريدُ شَيْئاً آخَرَ؟ فَقالَ: نَعَمْ يا أَميرَ المُؤْمِنينَ، لَقَدْ جَعَلْتَ لي أُسْرَةً كَبيرَةً، فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يَأْكُلونَ؟ فَضَحِكَ المَهْدِيُّ وَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِمالٍ يَكْفي لِنَفَقَةِ بَيْتِهِ الجَديدِ.
dialogue.tr: wa qāl: wa qad amarnā laka bi-khādima. fa-hal turīdu shayʾan ākhar? faqāl: naʿam yā amīra l-muʾminīn, laqad jaʿalta lī usratan kabīra, faman ayna yaʾkulūn? faḍaḥika l-Mahdiyyu wa amara lahu bi-mālin yakfī li-nafaqati baytihi l-jadīd
dialogue.en: He said: We have also ordered a maid for you. Do you want anything else? He said: Yes, Commander of the Faithful, you have given me a big family, so where will they eat from? Al-Mahdi laughed and ordered him enough money for the upkeep of his new household.
dialogue.ur: Khalifa ne kaha: Aur hum ne tumhare liye khadima ka hukm diya. Kuch aur chahiye? Bola: Haan Ameer-ul-Momineen, aapne mera bada khandan bana diya hai, woh kahan se khayenge? Mahdi hansa aur naye ghar ke kharch ke liye kaafi maal dene ka hukm diya.

dialogue.ar: ذَكَرَ ابْنُ الجَوْزِيِّ في «كِتابِ الأَذْكِياءِ» أَنَّ وَلَداً صَغيراً جَلَسَ مَعَ قَوْمٍ يَأْكُلونَ فَبَكى.
dialogue.tr: dhakara bnu l-Jawzī fī Kitābi l-Adhkiyāʾ anna waladan ṣaghīran jalasa maʿa qawmin yaʾkulūna fabakā
dialogue.en: Ibn al-Jawzi mentions in 'The Book of the Clever' that a small boy sat with people who were eating, and cried.
dialogue.ur: Ibn al-Jauzi ne «Kitab al-Adhkiya» mein likha ke ek chhota bachcha khane wale logon ke saath baitha aur ro pada.

dialogue.ar: قالوا: لِماذا تَبْكي؟ قالَ: الطَّعامُ حارٌّ. قالوا: اتْرُكْهُ حَتّى يَبْرُدَ. قالَ: أَنْتُمْ لا تَتْرُكونَهُ!
dialogue.tr: qālū: limādhā tabkī? qāl: aṭ-ṭaʿāmu ḥārr. qālū: utrukhu ḥattā yabrud. qāl: antum lā tatrukūnah
dialogue.en: They asked: Why are you crying? He said: The food is hot. They said: Leave it until it cools. He said: But you are not leaving it!
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne poocha: Kyun ro rahe ho? Bola: Khana garam hai. Kaha: Thanda hone tak chhor do. Bola: Aap to chhor nahin rahe!

dialogue.ar: مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلى جُحا وَهُوَ يَحْفِرُ حُفْرَةً في الصَّحْراءِ، وَلَمّا سَأَلَهُ عَنْ سَبَبِ ذَلِكَ قالَ: دَفَنْتُ في هَذِهِ الصَّحْراءِ دَراهِمَ، لا أَعْرِفُ مَكانَها.
dialogue.tr: marra rajulun ʿalā Juḥā wa huwa yaḥfiru ḥufratan fiṣ-ṣaḥrāʾ, wa lammā saʾalahu ʿan sababi dhālika qāl: dafantu fī hādhihi ṣ-ṣaḥrāʾi darāhim, lā aʿrifu makānahā
dialogue.en: A man passed Juha as he was digging a hole in the desert. When asked why, he said: I buried dirhams in this desert and I don't know where.
dialogue.ur: Ek aadmi Juha ke paas se guzra jo registan mein gadha khod raha tha. Wajah poochi to bola: Maine is registan mein dirham dafn kiye, jagah yaad nahin.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ: كانَ يَجِبُ أَنْ تَجْعَلَ عَلَيْها عَلامَةً. قالَ جُحا: قَدْ فَعَلْتُ. قالَ الرَّجُلُ: وَما عَلامَتُكَ؟ قالَ: سَحابَةٌ في السَّماءِ كانَتْ تُظِلُّها.
dialogue.tr: faqāla lahu r-rajul: kāna yajibu an tajʿala ʿalayhā ʿalāmah. qāla Juḥā: qad faʿalt. qāla r-rajul: wa mā ʿalāmatuk? qāl: saḥābatun fis-samāʾi kānat tuẓilluhā
dialogue.en: The man said: You should have put a mark on it. Juha said: I did. The man said: What is your mark? He said: A cloud in the sky that was shading it.
dialogue.ur: Aadmi ne kaha: Us par nishani rakhni chahiye thi. Juha bola: Rakhi thi. Poocha: Tumhari nishani kya hai? Bola: Aasman mein ek badal jo us par saya kar raha tha.

dialogue.ar: اشْتَرى جُحا عَشَرَةَ حَميرٍ، وَرَكِبَ واحِداً مِنْها، وَحَسَبَها، فَإِذا هِيَ تِسْعَةٌ فَنَزَلَ ثُمَّ حَسَبَها، فَإِذا هِيَ عَشَرَةٌ، فَقالَ: أَمْشي وَأَرْبَحُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ أَرْكَبَ وَأَخْسَرَ حِماراً.
dialogue.tr: ishtarā Juḥā ʿasharata ḥamīr, wa rakiba wāḥidan minhā, wa ḥasabahā, fa-idhā hiya tisʿatun fanazala thumma ḥasabahā, fa-idhā hiya ʿashara, faqāl: amshī wa arbaḥu khayrun min an arkaba wa akhsara ḥimārā
dialogue.en: Juha bought ten donkeys, rode one and counted them: nine. He got down and counted again: ten. He said: Walking and gaining is better than riding and losing a donkey.
dialogue.ur: Juha ne das gadhe kharide, ek par sawar hua aur ginti ki to nau nikle. Utra aur phir ginti ki to das the. Bola: Paidal chalna aur nafa lena behtar hai is se ke sawar ho kar ek gadha ganwa doon.

q.en: Why did Imran's wife say they were both in Paradise?
q.ur: Imran ki biwi ne kyun kaha ke dono jannat mein hain?
q.ar: لِماذا قالَتْ زَوْجَةُ عِمْرانَ إِنَّهُما في الجَنَّةِ؟

options: He was thankful and she was patient
They gave a lot of charity

q.en: What did Abu Dulama ask the caliph for first?
q.ur: Abu Dulama ne Khalifa se sab se pehle kya manga?
q.ar: ماذا طَلَبَ أَبو دُلامَةَ مِنَ الخَليفَةِ أَوَّلًا؟

q.en: What was Juha's mark on his buried money?
q.ur: Juha ki dafn kiye hue paison ki nishani kya thi?
q.ar: ما العَلامَةُ الَّتي وَضَعَها جُحا عَلى مَكانِ مالِهِ المَدْفونِ؟

q.en: Why did the small boy cry at the meal?
q.ar: لِماذا بَكى الوَلَدُ الصَّغيرُ عَلى المائِدَةِ؟

options: He said the food was hot but they didn't leave it
options_ar: قالَ إِنَّ الطَّعامَ حارٌّ وَهُمْ لَمْ يَتْرُكوهُ

intro.en: After reading, you check your understanding. Mark each sentence true or false and fix the mistake, match titles to paragraphs, then learn the meanings of new words from their definitions.
intro.ur: Parhne ke baad hum apni samajh jaanchte hain. Har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat batayein aur ghalti theek karein, unwan ko hisson se milayein, phir naye alfaz ke matlab seekhein.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ القِراءَةِ تَتَحَقَّقُ مِنْ فَهْمِكَ: تُحَدِّدُ الجُمَلَ الصَّحيحَةَ وَالخاطِئَةَ وَتُصَحِّحُ الخَطَأَ، وَتُطابِقُ العَناوينَ بِالفِقَراتِ، ثُمَّ تَتَعَلَّمُ مَعاني الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةِ مِنْ تَعْريفاتِها.

dialogue.ar: الصّابِرُ وَالشّاكِرُ يَدْخُلانِ الجَنَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: aṣ-ṣābiru wash-shākiru yadkhulāni l-jannah
dialogue.en: The patient and the thankful enter Paradise. (Correct)
dialogue.ur: Sabr karne wala aur shukr karne wala jannat mein jaate hain. (Durust)

dialogue.ar: بَكى الطِّفْلُ لِأَنَّ الطَّعامَ حارٌّ.
dialogue.tr: bakā ṭ-ṭiflu li-anna ṭ-ṭaʿāma ḥārr
dialogue.en: The child cried because the food was hot. (Correct)
dialogue.ur: Bachcha is liye roya ke khana garam tha. (Durust)

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَضَعْ جُحا عَلامَةً في المَكانِ الَّذي وَضَعَ فيهِ الدَّراهِمَ.
dialogue.tr: lam yaḍaʿ Juḥā ʿalāmatan fil-makāni lladhī waḍaʿa fīhi d-darāhim
dialogue.en: Juha did not put a mark where he put the dirhams. (Wrong: his mark was the cloud.)
dialogue.ur: Juha ne wahan nishani nahin rakhi jahan paise rakhe. (Ghalat: us ki nishani badal thi.)

dialogue.ar: أَكَلَ أَشْعَبُ مَعَ رَجُلٍ قابَلَهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ.
dialogue.tr: akala Ashʿabu maʿa rajulin qābalahu min qabl
dialogue.en: Ash'ab ate with a man he had met before. (Wrong: they did not know him.)
dialogue.ur: Ash'ab ne aise aadmi ke saath khaya jisse pehle mila tha. (Ghalat: woh use nahin jaante the.)

q.en: Which word means «a place where things are bought and sold»?
q.ur: «Jahan cheezein khareedi aur bechi jaati hain» kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني «مَكانًا يُبْتاعُ فيهِ الأَشْياءُ وَتُباعُ»؟

q.en: Which word means «a person who works serving in homes»?
q.ur: «Gharon mein khidmat karne wala shakhs» kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني «شَخْصًا يَعْمَلُ في خِدْمَةِ البُيوتِ»؟

q.en: Which is the organ of the body used to see?
q.ur: Jism ka kaun sa hissa dekhne ke liye hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني عُضْوَ الجِسْمِ الَّذي نُبْصِرُ بِهِ؟

intro.en: A badal is a word that comes right after another word and explains it, taking the same case ending. Example: «سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ» – 'Muhammad' names 'your brother'. There are three kinds: whole for whole, part for whole, and inclusion.
intro.ur: Badal woh lafz hai jo kisi lafz ke foran baad aata hai, uski wazahat karta hai aur usi jaisa i'rab leta hai. Misal: «سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ» – 'Muhammad' 'aap ke bhai' ka naam batata hai. Iski teen qismein hain: kul ka kul, kul ka juz, aur ishtimal.
intro.ar: البَدَلُ تابِعٌ يَأْتي بَعْدَ كَلِمَةٍ وَيُوَضِّحُها، وَيَتْبَعُها في الإِعْرابِ. مِثالٌ: «سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ»؛ «مُحَمَّدٌ» يُبَيِّنُ مَنْ هُوَ «أَخوكَ». وَأَنْواعُهُ ثَلاثَةٌ: بَدَلُ كُلٍّ مِنْ كُلٍّ، وَبَدَلُ بَعْضٍ مِنْ كُلٍّ، وَبَدَلُ اشْتِمالٍ.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ.
dialogue.tr: sāfara akhūka Muḥammad
dialogue.en: Your brother Muhammad travelled. (whole for whole)
dialogue.ur: Aap ke bhai Muhammad ne safar kiya. (kul ka kul)

dialogue.ar: قَرَأْتُ الكِتابَ نِصْفَهُ.
dialogue.tr: qaraʾtu l-kitāba niṣfahu
dialogue.en: I read the book, half of it. (part for whole)
dialogue.ur: Maine kitab parhi, uska aadha. (kul ka juz)

dialogue.ar: أَعْجَبَني الطّالِبُ ذَكاؤُهُ.
dialogue.tr: aʿjabanī ṭ-ṭālibu dhakāʾuhu
dialogue.en: I admired the student, his intelligence. (inclusion)
dialogue.ur: Mujhe talib pasand aaya, uski zehanat. (ishtimal)

dialogue.ar: يُعْجِبُني الرَّجُلُ عِلْمُهُ.
dialogue.tr: yuʿjibunī r-rajulu ʿilmuhu
dialogue.en: I like the man, his knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe aadmi pasand hai, uska ilm.

options: A word that follows another and clarifies it

q.en: In «سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ» which word is the badal?
q.ur: «سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ» mein badal kaun sa hai?
q.ar: في «سافَرَ أَخوكَ مُحَمَّدٌ»، أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ هِيَ البَدَلُ؟

q.en: In «قَرَأْتُ الكِتابَ نِصْفَهُ» the badal is:
«أَعْجَبَني الطّالِبُ ذَكاؤُهُ» is which kind of badal?
q.ur: «أَعْجَبَني الطّالِبُ ذَكاؤُهُ» kaun si qism ka badal hai?
q.ar: «أَعْجَبَني الطّالِبُ ذَكاؤُهُ» أَيُّ أَنْواعِ البَدَلِ هذا؟

title.ur: Sun kar samajhna: Juha aur chor

intro.en: Listen to the story of Juha in two parts, then put the events in order and answer questions. In the story Juha sees a figure in the garden at night, fears it is a thief and fires at it. In the morning he finds it was his own clothes!
intro.ur: Juha ki kahani do hisson mein suniye, phir waqiat ko tarteeb dein aur sawalon ke jawab dein. Kahani mein Juha raat ko baagh mein ek jism dekhta hai, chor samajh kar goli chalata hai. Subah dekhta hai to woh uske apne kapde the!
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى حِكايَةِ جُحا في جُزْأَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تُرَتِّبُ الأَحْداثَ وَتُجيبُ. في الحِكايَةِ يَرى جُحا شَبَحًا في البُسْتانِ لَيْلًا، فَيَخافُ أَنْ يَكونَ لِصًّا وَيُطْلِقُ عَلَيْهِ النّارَ، وَفي الصَّباحِ يَجِدُهُ ثِيابَهُ هُوَ!

dialogue.ar: جُحا يَنامُ مِنْ شِدَّةِ التَّعَبِ.
dialogue.tr: Juḥā yanāmu min shiddati t-taʿab
dialogue.en: Juha sleeps from great tiredness.
dialogue.ur: Juha thakan ki shiddat se so jata hai.

dialogue.ar: الزَّوْجَةُ تَغْسِلُ ثَوْبَ جُحا.
dialogue.tr: az-zawjatu taghsilu thawba Juḥā
dialogue.en: The wife washes Juha's garment.
dialogue.ur: Biwi Juha ka kapda dhoti hai.

dialogue.ar: جُحا يَرى جِسْماً في الظَّلامِ.
dialogue.tr: Juḥā yarā jisman fiẓ-ẓalām
dialogue.en: Juha sees a figure in the darkness.
dialogue.ur: Juha andhere mein ek jism dekhta hai.

dialogue.ar: جُحا يُطْلِقُ الرَّصاصَ عَلى الجِسْمِ.
dialogue.tr: Juḥā yuṭliqu r-raṣāṣa ʿalā l-jism
dialogue.en: Juha fires bullets at the figure.
dialogue.ur: Juha jism par goliyan chalata hai.

dialogue.ar: جُحا يَحْمَدُ اللهَ وَيَشْكُرُهُ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: Juḥā yaḥmadu llāha wa yashkuruhu kathīran
dialogue.en: Juha praises Allah and thanks Him a lot.
dialogue.ur: Juha Allah ki hamd aur shukr bohat karta hai.

q.ur: «Baagh» ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني أَرْضًا فيها أَشْجارٌ وَأَزْهارٌ بِجانِبِ البَيْتِ؟

intro.en: In this lesson you talk about funny stories (nawadir wa turaf) with a partner: Do you like them? Is there a character like Juha in your culture? Then you retell each story in your own words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein aap apne saathi ke saath mazahiya qisson (nawadir wa turaf) ke baare mein baat karte hain: Kya aapko pasand hain? Kya aapki saqafat mein Juha jaisa kirdar hai? Phir har qissa apne alfaz mein sunate hain.
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَنِ النَّوادِرِ وَالطُّرَفِ: هَلْ تُحِبُّها؟ هَلْ في ثَقافَتِكَ شَخْصِيَّةٌ مِثْلُ جُحا؟ ثُمَّ تَرْوي كُلَّ حِكايَةٍ بِأُسْلوبِكَ.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تُحِبُّ قِراءَةَ النَّوادِرِ وَالطُّرَفِ؟ لِماذا؟
dialogue.tr: hal tuḥibbu qirāʾata n-nawādiri waṭ-ṭuraf? limādhā?
dialogue.en: Do you like reading funny stories? Why?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapko nawadir aur turaf parhna pasand hai? Kyun?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ في ثَقافَتِكَ شَخْصِيَّةٌ مِثْلُ جُحا؟ ما اسْمُها؟
dialogue.tr: hal fī thaqāfatika shakhṣiyyatun mithlu Juḥā? mā ismuhā?
dialogue.en: Is there a character like Juha in your culture? What is its name?
dialogue.ur: Kya aapki saqafat mein Juha jaisa kirdar hai? Uska naam kya hai?

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تِلْكَ الشَّخْصِيّاتُ حَقيقِيَّةٌ أَمْ خَيالِيَّةٌ؟
dialogue.tr: hal tilka sh-shakhṣiyyātu ḥaqīqiyyatun am khayāliyyah?
dialogue.en: Are those characters real or imaginary?
dialogue.ur: Kya yeh kirdar haqiqi hain ya khayali?

dialogue.ar: الطُّرْفَةُ الأولى: عِمْرانُ مَعَ زَوْجَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭurfatu l-ūlā: ʿImrānu maʿa zawjatih
dialogue.en: Story one: Imran with his wife.
dialogue.ur: Pehla qissa: Imran apni biwi ke saath.

dialogue.ar: الطُّرْفَةُ السّادِسَةُ: جُحا وَحِمارُهُ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭurfatu s-sādisa: Juḥā wa ḥimāruh
dialogue.en: Story six: Juha and his donkey.
dialogue.ur: Chhata qissa: Juha aur uska gadha.

q.ur: «Story» ko Arabi mein kya kehte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني ما يُرْوى مِنْ أَحْداثٍ وَأَخْبارٍ؟

title.en: Spelling: Hamza at the end of a word
title.ur: Imla: Lafz ke aakhir ki hamza

intro.en: When hamza comes at the end of a word, how it is written depends on the vowel before it: after kasra it sits on ya (ئ), after damma on waw (ؤ), after fatha on alif (أ), and after a sukun it stands alone (ء).
intro.ur: Jab hamza lafz ke aakhir mein aati hai to uska likhna us se pehle wali harkat par hota hai: kasra ke baad ya par (ئ), damma ke baad waw par (ؤ), fatha ke baad alif par (أ), aur sukun ke baad akeli (ء).
intro.ar: عِنْدَما تَأْتي الهَمْزَةُ في آخِرِ الكَلِمَةِ تَعْتَمِدُ كِتابَتُها عَلى الحَرَكَةِ قَبْلَها: بَعْدَ الكَسْرَةِ عَلى ياءٍ (ئ)، وَبَعْدَ الضَّمَّةِ عَلى واوٍ (ؤ)، وَبَعْدَ الفَتْحَةِ عَلى أَلِفٍ (أ)، وَبَعْدَ السُّكونِ تُكْتَبُ وَحْدَها (ء).

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ كَسْرٍ: ئ — قُرِئَ، بَرِئَ، شاطِئ
dialogue.tr: baʿda kasr: hamza on yāʾ — qurīʾa, barīʾa, shāṭiʾ
dialogue.en: After kasra: ئ — it was read, he was innocent, shore
dialogue.ur: Kasra ke baad: ئ — parha gaya, bari hua, sahil

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ ضَمٍّ: ؤ — لُؤْلُؤ، جَرُؤَ، تَباطُؤ، وُضُوء
dialogue.tr: baʿda ḍamm: hamza on wāw — luʾluʾ, jaruʾa, tabāṭuʾ, wuḍūʾ
dialogue.en: After damma: ؤ — pearl, he dared, slowness, ablution
dialogue.ur: Damma ke baad: ؤ — moti, himmat ki, sust-rawi, wuzu

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ فَتْحٍ: أ — قَرَأَ، فَقَأَ، بَدَأَ، مَلَأَ
dialogue.tr: baʿda fatḥ: hamza on alif — qaraʾa, faqaʾa, badaʾa, malaʾa
dialogue.en: After fatha: أ — he read, he burst, he began, he filled
dialogue.ur: Fatha ke baad: أ — usne parha, phor diya, shuru kiya, bhar diya

dialogue.ar: بَعْدَ سُكونٍ: ء — جُزْء، سَوْء، مِلْء، إِمْلاء
dialogue.tr: baʿda sukūn: hamza alone — juzʾ, sawʾ, milʾ, imlāʾ
dialogue.en: After sukun: ء — part, evil, fullness, dictation
dialogue.ur: Sukun ke baad: ء — hissa, burai, bhar, imla

q.en: Hamza after kasra is written on:
q.ur: Kasra ke baad hamza kis par likhi jati hai?

q.en: Hamza after damma is written on:
q.ur: Damma ke baad hamza kis par likhi jati hai?

q.en: Which word has hamza on alif?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein hamza alif par hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ فيها هَمْزَةٌ عَلى أَلِفٍ؟

q.en: In «جُزْء» the hamza stands alone because it comes after:
q.ur: «جُزْء» mein hamza akeli kyun hai? Kyunke us se pehle:
q.ar: في «جُزْء» تُكْتَبُ الهَمْزَةُ وَحْدَها لِأَنَّها جاءَتْ بَعْدَ:

options_ar: حَجَرٌ كَريمٌ أَبْيَضُ يُخْرَجُ مِنَ المَحارِ

intro.en: Tawkid is emphasis. Verbal emphasis repeats the same word: «باطِلٌ باطِلٌ». Meaning emphasis uses words like نَفْسُهُ, عَيْنُهُ, كُلُّهُ, كِلاهُما, كِلْتاهُما. Example: «هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ».
intro.ur: Tawkid ka matlab zor dena hai. Lafzi tawkid mein wohi lafz dohraya jata hai: «باطِلٌ باطِلٌ». Ma'nawi tawkid mein نَفْسُهُ، عَيْنُهُ، كُلُّهُ، كِلاهُما، كِلْتاهُما jaise alfaz aate hain. Misal: «هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ».
intro.ar: التَّوْكيدُ هُوَ تَقْوِيَةُ المَعْنى. التَّوْكيدُ اللَّفْظِيُّ يُكَرِّرُ الكَلِمَةَ نَفْسَها: «باطِلٌ باطِلٌ». وَالتَّوْكيدُ المَعْنَوِيُّ يَسْتَعْمِلُ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلَ نَفْسُهُ وَعَيْنُهُ وَكُلُّهُ وَكِلاهُما وَكِلْتاهُما. مِثالٌ: «هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ».

dialogue.ar: هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā huwa l-amīru nafsuh
dialogue.en: This is the prince himself.
dialogue.ur: Yeh khud ameer hai.

dialogue.ar: رَأَيْتُ الكِتابَ عَيْنَهُ.
dialogue.tr: raʾaytu l-kitāba ʿaynah
dialogue.en: I saw the very book.
dialogue.ur: Maine wohi kitab dekhi.

dialogue.ar: تَقَدَّمَ الطّالِبانِ أَنْفُسُهُما.
dialogue.tr: taqaddama ṭ-ṭālibāni anfusuhumā
dialogue.en: The two students themselves came forward.
dialogue.ur: Dono talib khud aage barhe.

dialogue.ar: أَكْرَمْتُ كِلا الطّالِبَيْنِ، وَسافَرَتْ كِلْتا الطّالِبَتَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: akramtu kilā ṭ-ṭālibayn, wa sāfarat kiltā ṭ-ṭālibatayn
dialogue.en: I honoured both students; both female students travelled.
dialogue.ur: Maine dono talibon ki izzat ki; dono talibat ne safar kiya.

dialogue.ar: كَلّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمونَ ثُمَّ كَلّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمونَ.
dialogue.tr: kallā sawfa taʿlamūn thumma kallā sawfa taʿlamūn
dialogue.en: No! You will soon know. Again, no! You will soon know.
dialogue.ur: Hargiz nahin! Tum jald jaan loge. Phir hargiz nahin! Tum jald jaan loge.

q.en: Which is verbal emphasis (repeating the same word)?
q.ur: Lafzi tawkid kaun si hai (wohi lafz dohrana)?
q.ar: أَيُّ الأَمْثِلَةِ تَوْكيدٌ لَفْظِيٌّ (تَكْرارُ الكَلِمَةِ نَفْسِها)؟

q.en: In «هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ» the emphasis word is:
q.ur: «هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ» mein tawkid ka lafz hai:
q.ar: في «هَذا هُوَ الأَميرُ نَفْسُهُ» ما كَلِمَةُ التَّوْكيدِ؟

intro.en: This is a review test with hadiths, a reading text about the Sunnah, vocabulary and grammar. Read the texts, then answer the questions. The reading says the Sunnah is the second source of Islam after the Qur'an.
intro.ur: Yeh dohrai ka imtihan hai jis mein ahadees, Sunnat ke baare mein ek tehreer, alfaz aur qawaid hain. Matan parhein phir sawalat ke jawab dein. Matan batata hai ke Sunnat Quran ke baad Islam ka doosra masdar hai.
intro.ar: هذا اخْتِبارُ مُراجَعَةٍ فيهِ أَحاديثُ، وَنَصٌّ عَنِ السُّنَّةِ، وَمُفْرَداتٌ وَقَواعِدُ. اِقْرَأِ النُّصوصَ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ. يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ أَنَّ السُّنَّةَ هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الثّاني لِلْإِسْلامِ بَعْدَ القُرْآنِ.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «الجَنَّةُ تَحْتَ أَقْدامِ الأُمَّهاتِ».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: al-jannatu taḥta aqdāmi l-ummahāt
dialogue.en: The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: Paradise lies at the feet of mothers.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Jannat maaon ke qadmon ke neeche hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «تَنَزَّهوا مِنَ البَوْلِ؛ فَإِنَّ عامَّةَ عَذابِ القَبْرِ مِنْهُ».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūl: tanazzahū mina l-bawl; fa-inna ʿāmmata ʿadhābi l-qabri minh
dialogue.en: The Messenger said: Keep clean from urine, for most of the punishment of the grave is from it.
dialogue.ur: Rasool ﷺ ne farmaya: Peshab se bacho, kyunke qabr ke azab ka ziyada hissa usi se hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمَرَ اللهُ سُبْحانَهُ وَتَعالى الرَّسولَ ﷺ أَنْ يُبَلِّغَ القُرْآنَ الكَريمَ بِكُلِّ دِقَّةٍ وَأَمانَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: amara llāhu subḥānahu wa taʿālā r-rasūla an yuballigha l-Qurʾāna l-karīma bi-kulli diqqatin wa amāna
dialogue.en: Allah, glorified and exalted, commanded the Messenger to convey the noble Qur'an with all precision and trust.
dialogue.ur: Allah ta'ala ne Rasool ﷺ ko hukm diya ke Quran Kareem poori dikkat aur amanat ke saath pahunchaein.

dialogue.ar: هَذا يَعْني أَنَّ السُّنَّةَ هِيَ المَصْدَرُ الثّاني لِلْإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā yaʿnī anna s-sunnata hiya l-maṣdaru th-thānī lil-islām
dialogue.en: This means that the Sunnah is the second source of Islam.
dialogue.ur: Iska matlab hai ke Sunnat Islam ka doosra masdar hai.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الصَّحابَةُ يَحْفَظونَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ كُلَّ أَقْوالِهِ وَأَفْعالِهِ وَتَقْريراتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna ṣ-ṣaḥābatu yaḥfaẓūna ʿani n-nabiyyi kulla aqwālihi wa afʿālihi wa taqrīrātih
dialogue.en: The Companions memorised from the Prophet all his sayings, actions and approvals.
dialogue.ur: Sahaba Nabi ﷺ ke tamam aqwal, af'al aur taqrirat yaad rakhte the.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ المُبارَكِ: «الإِسْنادُ مِنَ الدِّينِ، وَلَوْلا الإِسْنادُ لَقالَ مَنْ شاءَ ما شاءَ».
dialogue.tr: wa qāla ʿAbdu llāhi bnu l-Mubārak: al-isnādu mina d-dīn, wa lawlā l-isnādu laqāla man shāʾa mā shāʾ
dialogue.en: Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak said: The chain of narration is part of the religion; without it anyone could say whatever they wished.
dialogue.ur: Abdullah bin al-Mubarak ne kaha: Isnad deen ka hissa hai; isnad na hota to har koi jo chahta kehta.

q.en: According to the hadith, Paradise lies:
q.ur: Hadees ke mutabiq jannat kahan hai?

q.en: The reading says the second source of Islam is:
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq Islam ka doosra masdar hai:
q.ar: يَذْكُرُ النَّصُّ أَنَّ المَصْدَرَ الثّانِيَ لِلْإِسْلامِ هُوَ:

q.ur: Sahaba Nabi ﷺ ke kya yaad rakhte the?
